title: ReAccess: Look Once, Stay Focused with Efficient Test Time Memory

alt.en: ReAccess framework showing memory construction and utilization for vision-language reasoning.
alt.zh: ReAccess 框架图，展示视觉语言推理中的记忆构建与利用。

caption.en: Figure 2. ReAccess constructs visual memory during prefill and retrieves evidence during reasoning.
caption.zh: 原论文图 2。ReAccess 在预填充阶段构建视觉记忆，并在推理时检索相关证据。

summary.en: Builds a compact visual memory in a single image pass and retrieves question-relevant evidence during inference to support fine-grained visual reasoning.
summary.zh: 通过一次图像编码构建紧凑视觉记忆，并在推理时检索与问题相关的证据，支持细粒度视觉推理。

title: ER-Chord: Spatially Consistent One-Step Image Editing via Equal-Energy Reliability Redistribution

alt.en: ER-Chord framework for reliability-guided spatial redistribution in one-step editing.
alt.zh: ER-Chord 单步图像编辑框架，展示基于可靠性的空间重分配。

caption.en: Figure 1. ER-Chord estimates local reliability from endpoint agreement and redistributes a fixed control-energy budget.
caption.zh: 原论文图 1。ER-Chord 根据端点一致性估计局部可靠性，并在总控制能量固定的条件下重新分配编辑强度。

summary.en: Redistributes a fixed editing-energy budget toward spatially reliable regions, improving source preservation in one-step image editing.
summary.zh: 在总编辑能量固定的条件下，将编辑强度重新分配到可靠区域，从而在单步图像编辑中更好地保留原图。

title: X-MoD: Practical Scaling Laws for Sparse-Depth Routing Beyond Mixture-of-Depths

alt.en: MoD and X-MoD diagrams comparing layer organization and token routing within a layer.
alt.zh: MoD 与 X-MoD 的层间结构及层内 token 路由机制对比图。

caption.en: MoD and X-MoD architecture and routing mechanisms.
caption.zh: MoD 与 X-MoD 的结构和路由机制。

summary.en: Introduces a sparse-depth architecture that decouples token sparsity from the spacing of dense layers, and derives scaling laws for choosing routing configurations under a compute budget.
summary.zh: 提出将 token 稀疏率与稠密层间隔解耦的稀疏深度架构，并建立缩放定律，指导给定算力预算下的路由配置选择。

title: The Coupling Tax: How Shared Token Budgets Undermine Visible Chain-of-Thought Under Fixed Output Limits

alt.en: Two plots compare thinking and non-thinking accuracy against token budget and actual token use.
alt.zh: 两幅曲线图比较思考与非思考模式的准确率随 token 预算和实际用量的变化。

caption.en: Accuracy under matched token budgets and actual token usage.
caption.zh: 相同 token 预算及实际 token 用量下的准确率对比。

summary.en: Shows how explicit reasoning can crowd out final answers when both share a fixed token budget, and evaluates a strategy that budgets them separately.
summary.zh: 揭示显式推理与最终答案共享固定 token 预算时，推理过程可能挤占答案空间，并评估了分别分配预算的策略。

title: Gradient Starvation in Binary-Reward GRPO: Why Group-Mean Centering Fails and Why the Simplest Fix Works

alt.en: Bar chart comparing GSM8K accuracy for Sign, alternative advantage formulations, DrGRPO, and the base model.
alt.zh: 柱状图比较 Sign、其他优势函数、DrGRPO 和基础模型的 GSM8K 准确率。

caption.en: GSM8K accuracy with different advantage formulations.
caption.zh: 不同优势函数下的 GSM8K 准确率。

summary.en: Explains why GRPO loses its learning signal when all responses in a group receive the same binary reward, and evaluates a fixed-reference sign advantage to address this failure.
summary.zh: 解释 GRPO 在组内响应获得相同二值奖励时为何失去学习信号，并评估了用固定参照的符号优势函数缓解这一问题的方法。

title: Maximum Score Routing For Mixture-of-Experts
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2025

alt.en: Token-to-expert routing represented as a minimum-cost maximum-flow graph with a source and sink.
alt.zh: 将Token到专家的路由表示为带有源节点和汇节点的最小费用最大流图。

caption.en: Minimum-cost maximum-flow formulation of MoE routing.
caption.zh: MoE路由的最小费用最大流建模。

summary.en: Models token-to-expert assignment as a minimum-cost maximum-flow problem and combines it with SoftTopk to improve routing under expert capacity constraints.
summary.zh: 将 token 到专家的分配建模为最小费用最大流问题，并结合 SoftTopk 改善专家容量约束下的路由。

title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation with Unstable Category Feature Enhancement
venue: ECAI 2025: 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence

alt.en: UCFE architecture with teacher–student segmentation, entropy-guided separation of unstable categories, and reverse spatial and global channel attention.
alt.zh: UCFE整体框架：教师—学生分割、基于熵的不稳定类别解耦，以及反向空间注意力和全局通道注意力。

caption.zh: 论文原图，图2 · UCFE整体框架

summary.en: Dynamically identifies unstable categories and enhances their features to improve semantic segmentation across domains without target-domain labels.
summary.zh: 在无需目标域标注的条件下，动态识别不稳定类别并增强其特征，以改善跨域语义分割。

title: Ultrasound image segmentation of thyroid nodule via latent semantic feature co-registration

alt.en: Thyroid ultrasound segmentation framework combining atlas and target semantic features, Half-STN registration, spatially transformed atlas labels, and weighted label fusion.
alt.zh: 甲状腺超声分割框架：图谱与目标图像的语义特征、Half-STN配准、图谱标签空间变换及加权标签融合。

caption.en: Original paper, Fig. 3 · Semantic extraction and deformation fusion
caption.zh: 论文原图，图3 · 语义提取与形变融合

summary.en: Registers atlas and target ultrasound images in a learned semantic feature space and fuses the aligned labels to segment thyroid nodules.
summary.zh: 在学习到的潜在语义特征空间中配准图谱与目标超声图像，并融合对齐后的标签，实现甲状腺结节分割。

title: Mamba-Dfan: Mamba-Driven Dual-Branch Frequency-Domain Network for Rgb-D and Rgb-T Salient Object Detection

alt.en: Mamba-DFAN architecture with dual-band frequency modeling and cross-modal feature fusion.
alt.zh: Mamba-DFAN 整体架构，展示双频段建模与跨模态特征融合。

caption.en: Figure 1. Mamba-DFAN architecture with dual-band frequency modeling and cross-modal feature fusion.
caption.zh: 原论文图 1。Mamba-DFAN 整体架构，展示双频段建模与跨模态特征融合。

summary.en: Uses Mamba to model low-frequency structure and high-frequency details, then adaptively fuses RGB with depth or thermal cues for salient object detection.
summary.zh: 利用 Mamba 建模低频结构与高频细节，并自适应融合 RGB 与深度或热红外信息，用于显著性目标检测。

title: Pixel-wise Reclassification with Prototypes for Enhancing Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
venue: ECAI 2024: 27th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence

alt.en: PtReCl architecture showing pseudo-mask restoration, prototype acquisition, pixel reclassification, and mask refinement.
alt.zh: PtReCl 架构，包含伪掩码恢复、原型获取、像素重分类和掩码再细化。

caption.en: Figure 3. PtReCl architecture showing pseudo-mask restoration, prototype acquisition, pixel reclassification, and mask refinement.
caption.zh: 原论文图 3。PtReCl 架构，包含伪掩码恢复、原型获取、像素重分类和掩码再细化。

summary.en: Learns foreground and background prototypes to reclassify pixels in noisy pseudo-masks, improving supervision for weakly supervised semantic segmentation.
summary.zh: 学习前景和背景原型，对含噪伪掩码中的像素进行重分类，为弱监督语义分割提供更准确的监督信号。

title: Balanced And Discriminative Contrastive Learning For Class-Imbalanced Medical Images
venue: ICASSP 2024 - 2024 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP)

alt.en: BDCL architecture with shared encoders, representation learning, classifier learning, and an epoch-dependent loss weight.
alt.zh: BDCL 双分支架构，展示共享编码器、表征学习、分类器学习及随训练轮次变化的损失权重。

caption.en: BDCL training framework, redrawn in English from the author-provided Chinese diagram.
caption.zh: BDCL 训练框架，根据作者提供的中文图重绘为英文版。

summary.en: Combines dynamic temperature learning with hard-example prototypes to learn more balanced and discriminative representations from class-imbalanced medical images.
summary.zh: 结合动态温度学习与困难样本原型，从类别不平衡的医学图像中学习更均衡、更具判别力的特征表征。
